title: Crop feeler system and method
abstract: In some embodiments, a crop feeler system automatically executes a navigational task based on a proximity of a vehicle to an obstacle. The crop feeler system includes a hub attached to the vehicle. Inside the hub are two oscillating circuits each having an oscillating frequency. A member is coupled to the hub. Two inductive elements are positioned within the member so that, when the obstacle comes into contact with the member, at least one of the inductive elements moves closer to at least one of the oscillating circuits and alters the oscillating frequency of that oscillating circuit. A navigation sensor measures the oscillating frequency of the oscillating circuit, identifies a navigational task using the oscillating frequency of the oscillating circuit, and executes the navigational task.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a work vehicle capable of preventing a reference position for a rectilinear travel from being acquired due to an improper operation and curtailing increase of the quantity of components.SOLUTION: The work vehicle includes: a steering member 35 for performing a steering operation to a vehicle body; a position information acquisition device 200 for acquiring positional coordinates of the vehicle body; an automatic rectilinear travel device 205 for causing the vehicle body to perform rectilinear travel by activating the steering member 35; and a control unit 100 for controlling each part of the vehicle body. The work vehicle is provided with an operation member 207 for acquiring a reference position to be a reference for rectilinear travel of the vehicle body and switching on/off the automatic rectilinear travel device 205. The reference position is acquired when operating the operation member 207 to a first direction W1, and an automatic steering device 205 is switched on when operating the operation member 207 in a second direction W2. The control unit 100 is configured to activate the automatic rectilinear travel device 205 by performing a switch-on operation to the operation member 207 in a state where the reference position is acquired.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: MOVING GEOFENCE FOR MACHINE TRACKING IN AGRICULTURE
abstract: An agricultural vehicle tracking system provides a moving geofence (16) about the location of a vehicle (10). When the moving geofence (16) contacts a point of interest, such as another moving geofence (16), an alert is issued. The particular characteristics of the moving geofence (16) may be generated in accordance with a predetermined scheme.

title: Trenching Device And System
abstract: A device for trenching and a system of controlling trenching at a constant depth and at a speed of more than 12 miles per hour.

title: Targeted application system for tobacco bud inhibitors
abstract: The invention relates to a targeted application system for tobacco bud inhibitors. The targeted application system comprises a single chip microcomputer system, a bracket, a tobacco stalk detection sensor, a speed measuring sensor, a stepping motor, a scroll, a steel wire rope, an electromagnetic valve, a slide block, a sliding rail, a check valve, a spraying pipe, a pulley and a bearing pedestal. According to the invention, the single chip microcomputer system controls the switching on and off of the electromagnetic valve according to whether a detection signal of the tobacco stalk detection sensor exists or not, and controls the rotating speed and rotating angle of the stepping motor according to the machine operating speed measured by the speed measuring sensor and preset spraying time, so that the automatic targeted spraying of the tobacco bud inhibitors can be realized, the production cost is reduced, and the labor productivity is improved; and the targeted application system disclosed by the invention is simple in structure and has a good spraying effect.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To provide a work vehicle capable of automatically traveling a machine body according to a created target straight route by creating a reciprocating work route constituted of straight routes and headland work routes with minimal effort even in fields having not performed work travel in the past or if not so, in cases of changing a work travel route.SOLUTION: A work vehicle comprises: headland route creation means 53 that creates a target straight route in a headland work process from a travel route of a machine body heading from a target straight route created by reciprocating route creation means 53 to a next target straight route, or from the travel route of the machine body heading for a start point of a teaching travel or the headland travel; and automatic steering means 73 that causes the machine body to travel according to the target straight route created by the reciprocating rout creation means or the headland route creation means.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: MULTIPLE SEED-TYPE PLANTING SYSTEM WITH CHARGING SYSTEM
abstract: A system (5) for planting multiple types of seed (17) and automatically switching between the varieties during planting in a single planting pass of a planting session of row-crop or other planting of an agricultural field. The system may include a bulk storage system (19), an on-row storage system (27), and a charging system (28) that selectively delivers seeds (17) of different varieties from the bulk storage system (19) to the on-row storage system (27). The system may include a seed metering system (35) that can be controlled at each of multiple row units (13) to selectively plant different types or varieties of seed (17) based on seed type or variety zones agricultural field, which may correspond to field characteristics defined in a seed variety prescription map.

title: Weight transferring hitch system for agricultural implement
abstract: An agricultural implement includes a main frame. The agricultural implement also includes at least one disc gang including a plurality of disc blades, wherein the at least one disc gang is coupled to the main frame. The agricultural implement further includes a hitch system coupled to the main frame, wherein the hitch system is configured to couple the agricultural implement to a work vehicle and to transfer weight between the work vehicle and the agricultural implement to adjust a downward force applied on each disc blade of the plurality of disc blades in engaging soil.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR FOLLOWING CROP ROW IN AGRICULTURAL IMPLEMENT
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To improve the following property of a working part towards a crop row in a management work.

SOLUTION: (1) This method for performing the management work is provided by making a continuous gutter in parallel to the crop row on sowing or transplanting seedlings, controlling the working part of an agricultural implement so as to follow the crop row and perform the management work while keeping the side directional position of the implement with the crop row uniformly by detecting the side directional relative position between the gutter and the agricultural implement during the management work. (2) This device for controlling to keep the side directional position of the working part 8 of the agricultural implement towards the crop row A uniformly so as to follow the crop row A is provided by making the continuous gutter 5 in parallel to the crop row A on sowing or transplanting the seedlings, installing a detecting device 10 for detecting the side directional relative position between the gutter 5 and the agricultural implement 6 at the agricultural implement and installing a detecting arm 12 moving by making a contact with the gutter 5 and sensors 14, 15 or a camera 13 for detecting the side directional position of the agricultural implement by the detecting arm 12, at the detecting device 10.

title: APPARATUS FOR PROVIDING AUTOMATIC STEERING STOP LOCATION INDICATION OF AGRICULTURAL WORKING MACHINE
abstract: The present invention relates to a device for providing an indication of an end location of automatic steering of an agricultural vehicle, more specifically, to a device for providing an indication of an end location of automatic steering of an agricultural vehicle, which is capable of increasing user convenience to keep eyes forward and reducing a safety accident rate by providing an indication of an end location of the automatic steering of an agricultural vehicle such as a tractor. The device (100) for providing the indication of an end location of an automatic steering of an agricultural vehicle (1) comprises: a route information receiving unit (130) receiving an automatic steering route including the end location of the automatic steering; a location measuring unit (140) generating location information with respect to a current location; a control unit (110) calculating a distance from the current location to the end location of the automatic steering during the automatic steering on the automatic steering route, and generating control signals when the distance is less than or equal to the first threshold; and an indicating unit (160) emitting beams to indicate the end location of the automatic steering according to the control signals.

title: Automated reverse implement parking
abstract: A guidance system identifies a parking path and a target point in a parking area. The guidance system calculates steering commands to steer the vehicle and trailer onto the parking path. The guidance system calculates a distance of the trailer from the target point and calculates speed commands for the vehicle based on the distance of the trailer from the target point. The guidance system sends the steering and speed commands to a steering and speed control system to steer the vehicle and move the trailer along the parking path until the trailer reaches the target point in the parking area.

title: Agricultural binocular multispectral camera
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural binocular multispectral camera, mainly comprising components such as a central processing unit based on an ARM, an image real-time collection module, an image remote transmission module, an image sensor switching selection circuit, a camera photographing triggering interface, a GNSS module, and so on. The central processing unit based on the ARM is the core component. The image collection module is composed of two CMOS image sensors and light filters of a visible light band and a near infrared band. The image transmission module transmits image information remotely. The image sensor switching selection circuit is used for controlling cameras of the two CMOS image sensors to photograph in sequence and generate corresponding image formats according to demands. According to the device, the agricultural production cost can be reduced. With the help of the GNSS positioning device, the timely and effective image and geographical location data can be provided for agricultural production, thereby facilitating development of precision agriculture.

title: DIRECTION ADJUSTING DEVICE AND APPLICATION THEREOF
abstract: A direction adjusting device (100) and an application thereof. The direction adjusting device (100) is allowed to be installed in a steering system (220) of a traveling body (200), and comprises a driving element (10) and a linkage element (20), the driving element (10) comprising an assembly housing (11) and a drive body (12); the drive body (12) is installed in an accommodation space (1101) of the assembly housing (11); a transmission channel (122) of the drive body (12) communicates with the accommodation space (1101) of the assembly housing (11), and the linkage element (20) is installed in the transmission channel (122) of the drive body (12); the drive body (12) may drive the linkage element (20) to rotate, and the linkage element (20) is installed in the steering system (220) of the traveling body (200).

title: Agricultural device
abstract: The agricultural device has a satellite navigation system e.g. Global positioning system (GPS)equipped with a computer system for recording of data, such as height profile of a processed agricultural area. Sensors, particularly tilt or ultrasonic sensors and optical sensors, are provided for determining the height of the ground. Multiple processing devices or plant components, such as mowing or material distributor, are located above the ground to regulate the operating parameters.

title: Regulation and control method for precise drip irrigation and fertilization under tomato film
abstract: The invention discloses a regulation and control method for precise drip irrigation and fertilization under a tomato film, and belongs to the technical field of fine planting of agricultural products. A water pump conveys a nutrient solution to a drip irrigation header pipe, the drip irrigation header pipe conveys the nutrient solution to drip irrigation branch pipes, the drip irrigation branch pipes convey the nutrient solution to drip irrigation capillary pipes, and finally, the nutrient solution drips from drip irrigation openings preset in the side walls of the drip irrigation capillary pipes; the nutrient solution dripped from the drip irrigation openings provides nutrition for tomato seedlings, a remote monitoring platform can obtain real-time moisture and humidity data, the water pumping amount of a water pump is adjusted according to actual requirements, a plurality of soil moisture sensors are used for collecting moisture data of soil at different positions, humidity monitoring sensors of different types are used for collecting humidity data of three-way connectors at different positions, and then data rechecking is carried out; and therefore, the pipeline blocking position and the tee joint water leakage position can be found in the first time, the pipeline can be replaced and overhauled in a targeted mode, and practicability is good.

title: AUTOMATIC TRAVEL SYSTEM FOR SPRAYING WORK
abstract: To provide an automatic travel system capable of properly and efficiently performing a spraying work to objects to be sprayed such as trees and crops arranged in a plurality of rows, by automatic travel of a work vehicle.SOLUTION: An automatic travel system for a spraying work comprises a target path creation part for creating a target path P for a spraying work, wherein spraying patterns of left and right liquid spraying parts 4L, 4R provided on a work vehicle V includes: a four-direction spraying pattern in which the respective left and right liquid spraying parts 4L, 4R perform spraying to both left and right directions; and a direction limited spraying pattern in which spraying directions by the left and right liquid spraying parts 4L, 4R are limited to three directions or less. The target path creation part creates the target path P by path setting including a four-direction spraying path Pw1 in which the four-direction spraying pattern is set as the spraying pattern, and direction limited spraying paths Pw2-Pw4 in which the direction limited spraying pattern is set as the spraying pattern.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 28

title: System and method for steering of an implement on sloped ground
abstract: A target steering angle is detected, where the target steering angle is associated with an implement steering system for tracking a planned implement path. A data processor determines whether or not the implement steering angle is at or near a maximum steering angle toward a lateral upslope of ground. The data processor determines whether the implement is aligned with the planned implement path. A controller or data processor adjusts a target vehicle steering angle of the vehicle to guide the implement toward the lateral upslope in alignment with the planned implement path such that the implement tracks the planned implement path if the implement steering angle is at or near the maximum steering angle.

title: USE OF COMPACTED CALCIUM-BASED GRANULES FOR SOIL CONDITIONING IN AGRICULTURE
abstract: The present invention is related to the use of compacted calcium-based granules, in particular pellets, in agriculture, in precision farming. The pellets are used as soil conditioning product, in particular as soil liming product, such as for deacidifying of the soil. The pellets are spheroidal/lens-shaped pellets comprising a source of calcium and optionally one or more additives.The pellets comprise at least 60 wt%, preferably 70 wt% of CaO, based on the total weight of the pellets.The pellets have an average size lower than 10 mm, measured by sieve analysis, and a granule density equal to or higher than 1.60 g/cm<sup>3</sup>, preferably equal to or higher than 1.70 g/cm<sup>3</sup> , measured by mercury picnometry.The present invention is further related to a precision farming method.

title: APPARATUSES AND METHODS FOR MANAGING AGRICULTURAL CROPS
abstract: An apparatus for managing agricultural crops includes a vehicle and a user interface. The vehicle includes a navigation system, one or more vision systems, one or more removal tools, and a control system. The control system can include a data processing system, a data storage system, and a targeting system. The apparatus can be used to carry out one or more methods for managing agricultural crops, such as, for example, utilizing the vision system to capture images of an item to be targeted for removal by the removal tool, and utilizing the control system to process the images and position the removal tool to remove the item.

title: Swath tracking system for an off-road vehicle
abstract: A swath tracking system for an off-road vehicle includes a control system with a processor and a memory. The control system is configured to receive a plurality of vehicle location points and a current vehicle state, wherein the current vehicle state comprises a current vehicle location, generate a planned vehicle path through one or more of the plurality of vehicle location points, generate a correction path from the current vehicle location to a point along the planned vehicle path ahead of the current vehicle location along a direction of travel, generate a blended path by blending the planned vehicle path and the correction path based at least in part on an assigned weight, wherein the assigned weight is based at least in part on a heading error, a distance between the current vehicle location and the planned path, or a combination thereof, and guide the off-road vehicle along the blended path.

title: AI-BASED CROP RECOMMENDATION SYSTEM FOR SMART FARMING TOWARDS AGRICULTURE 5.0
abstract: AI-BASED CROP RECOMMENDATION SYSTEM FOR SMART FARMING TOWARDS AGRICULTURE 5.0 According to a report of the Food and Agriculture Organization, the world population is projected to increase another two billion by 2050, while the arable region is expected to only grow by 5%. To increase productivity in agriculture, clever and effective agricultural techniques are therefore required. The determination of land adequacy for agriculture is a basic instrument for the growth of agriculture. Agriculture is using many emerging technologies and inventions as an approach to the gathering and distribution of agricultural knowledge. The rapid growth of wireless sensor networks has led to the creation of Internet of Things (IoT) of low cost and compact sensor devices, which are a feasible method for automating and making decisions in agriculture. This study proposes an expert framework for the evaluation of agricultural land suitability, by combining sensor networks with artificial intelligence systems such as neural networks and multi-component perceptron. This innovation would help farmers determine the farmland for agriculture according to four classes of judgment, i.e. more acceptable, suitable, reasonably appropriate and unsuitable. This measurement is based on the data from the different sensor instruments used for machine training. The results achieved by MLP with four hidden layers are seen in contrast to the other current model, to be successful for the multiclass classification system. This learned model is used to evaluate potential evaluations and to identify the land after each harvest. title: VIDEO DISPLAY SYSTEM AND WORK VEHICLE
abstract: This video display system comprises: an imaging device that is attached to a work vehicle to which a work machine is connected, and generates time series image data by capturing images in the advancement direction of the work vehicle; a screen; and a control device that causes a video based on the time series image data to be displayed on the screen. When the work machine is connected to the work vehicle on the side opposite the advancement direction of the work vehicle, the control device causes a composite video, in which the course of the work machine is superimposed over the video, to be displayed on the screen.

title: REMOTE CONTROL APPARATUS
abstract: A remote control apparatus 112 capable of communicating with a control apparatus 30 of an autonomously running work vehicle 1 via a communication apparatus 110, the remote control apparatus 112 comprising a communication apparatus 111, a control apparatus 119, a display apparatus 113, and cameras 42F, 42R for obtaining images of the front and rear, wherein the display apparatus 113 is provided with at least a remote control region 113A for controlling the autonomously running work vehicle 1, a peripheral image region 113B for displaying images captured by the cameras 42F, 42R, and a work status display region 113C, wherein the peripheral image region 113B is provided with a frontal view and a rear view.

title: WORK SUPPORT SYSTEM AND WORK SUPPORT DEVICE POSITIONED IN AN AREA
abstract: A work support system includes a positioning device to measure a position of a working object based on a signal of a positioning satellite, a notifier to issue notification of the working object based on whether the position of the working object measured by the positioning device is in an area, and an area changer to change a size of the area based on a number of the positioning satellite included in the signal received by the positioning device.

title: Robotic platform and method for performing multiple functions in agricultural systems
abstract: An autonomous vehicle platform system and method configured to perform various in-season management tasks, including selectively applying fertilizer, mapping growth zones and seeding cover crop within an agricultural field, while self-navigating between rows of planted crops and beneath the canopy of the planted crops on the uneven terrain of an agricultural field, allowing for an ideal in-season application of fertilizer to occur once the planted crop is well established and growing rapidly, in an effort to limit the loss of fertilizer.

title: Obscurant emission to assist image formation to automate agricultural management and treatment
abstract: Various embodiments relate generally to computer vision and automation to autonomously identify and deliver for application a treatment to an object among other objects, data science and data analysis, including machine learning, deep learning, and other disciplines of computer-based artificial intelligence to facilitate identification and treatment of objects, and robotics and mobility technologies to navigate a delivery system, more specifically, to an agricultural delivery system configured to identify and apply, for example, an agricultural treatment to an identified agricultural object. In some examples, a method may include calculating an amount of light originating from a light source sensed at a location in which an agricultural object is interposed between the light source and an image capture device, causing emission of an obscurant, and directing the obscurant to a region interposed between the light source and the agricultural object.

title: System and method for display of autonomous driving cultivation route
abstract: A device for displaying a work route comprises: a data receiving part that receives an image comprising a cultivation area; a route generating part that sets a work area in the cultivation area of the received image and generates a work route in the work area; a display part that displays a moving route of a following tractor on the working route; a position information processing part that determines a position of the tractor; and a control part that receives the work route generated by the route generating part, calculates the movement route of the tractor on the work route by receiving the position of the tractor from the position information processing part, and displays the movement route of the tractor on the work route through the display part. Therefore, the present invention is capable of allowing a user to easily grasp a work status.

title: Networked soybean low-temperature breeding intelligent monitoring system for precision agriculture
abstract: The invention provides a networked soybean low-temperature breeding intelligent monitoring system for precision agriculture. The networked soybean low-temperature breeding intelligent monitoring system comprises a breeding area, a mobile control terminal, a temperature acquisition and detection module, a digital display module and a prediction alarm module, the mobile control terminal sends a control request to each module distributed in the breeding area to complete preliminary parameter setting, and provides a basis for intelligent monitoring; temperature data and infrared images of each breeding area are collected in different time periods, fusion processing, detection and analysis are carried out, and a mobile control terminal formulates a related temperature adjusting strategy according to an analysis result; the whole breeding area is monitored, a prediction and early warning model is constructed according to a detection data analysis result, and prediction and alarm are carried out. The technical problems that in the prior art, monitoring of the breeding process is not perfect, and the supervision and feedback speed is low are solved.

title: Compounding improvement method for rhizosphere soil of fresh food jujubes in sand land
abstract: The invention discloses a compounding improvement method for rhizosphere soil of fresh food jujubes in sand land, and relates to the technical field of agricultural planting. The method comprises thefollowing steps that when jujube trees are planted in the sand land or direct sowing is conducted and a garden is established, red clay, sandy soil and organic fertilizer are mixed to form compound soil, and cultivation holes of the jujube trees are filled with the compound soil to improve the soil mass structure of the original sand land, wherein the volume ratio of the red clay to the sandy soilto the organic fertilizer is (3-5):(2-4):(2-4), preferably 4:3:3, the volume of the compound soil replacing original soil in each cultivation hole is 0.1 m<3>, and the compound soil per square metercontains 100 kg of superphosphate, 50 kg of oil residues and 10 kg of ferrous sulfate. By means of the method, the improved soil is used for replacement, the soil mass structure of the sand land is improved, the water storage and fertilizer retention performance of the sand land is improved, and the growth and fruiting capabilities of the fresh food jujubes in the sand land are improved; the method has the advantages that the survival rate of the jujube trees in the sand land during garden establishment is high, the growth and fruiting capabilities are high, the economic benefits are good, theinvestment is small, and the effect is quick.

title: A SYSTEM FOR SOIL QUALITY ANALYSIS
abstract: A SYSTEM FOR SOIL QUALITY ANALYSIS The present invention relates to a system for soil quality analysis. The object of the proposed invention is to monitor the gradation in soil in real time, by getting live stream of data and recommend the micronutrients to be added. IoT kit along with other accessories facilitates us for performing various processes for testing. title: UNDER DRAINAGE TO PREVENT FROM EXCESS SOIL MOISTURE IN PLANT
abstract: PURPOSE: A subsurface drainage method is provided to prevent damage to plant caused by excessive soil moisture and ensure good permeability of soil. CONSTITUTION: A subsurface drainage method is as follows. A vertical drain passage is installed with an excavation depth of about 1m, wherein the inclination from the entrance to the exit is about 0.1° for smooth drainage and water collection. The inclination between the front drain passage and the final drain passage is about 0.1° in order to facilitate the collection of water. Main drain passages formed by connecting perforated pipes in series are arranged successively at regular intervals and coupled with two-way pipes and three-way pipes on ends thereof to be connected to a collection well(14). The collected water is discharged to the outside of pavement with a water pump having an automatic level sensor.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce a burden of an operator in a work vehicle that repeats work travel and turning.SOLUTION: A work vehicle includes a positioning part 30 for detecting the position of a travelling machine body 50, a work travelling line acquisition part for acquiring work travelling lines L01 and L02, and a turning line acquisition part for acquiring a turning line LL1 that connects an end part of the work travelling line L01 and an end part of the next work travelling line L02. The work vehicle also includes an automatic travel control part for executing automatic steering so that the travelling machine body 50 travels along the work travelling lines L01 and L02 based on the position of the travelling machine body 50, and an automatic turning control part for executing automatic turning so that the travelling machine body 50 travels along the turning line LL1 based on the position of the travelling machine body 50. The work vehicle further includes a control part for switching the mode between a work mode in which the automatic travel control part is actuated and a turning mode in which the automatic turning control part is actuated.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 13

title: Autonomous agricultural working machine and method of operation
abstract: The invention relates, inter alia, to a method for operating an autonomous agricultural work machine. A first current position of the agricultural work machine is determined by means of a first position-determining device. A second current position of the agricultural work machine is determined by means of a second position-determining device. A difference value which relates to a difference between the first current position and the second current position is determined. The work machine is operated autonomously as a function of the determined difference value.

title: Intelligent irrigation decision system for hilly mountain orchard based on internet of things
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent irrigation decision system for hilly mountain orchard based on internet of things, which utilizes a central processing device, a humidity sensor, a signal processing circuit, a temperature sensor, a carbon dioxide sensor, an image acquisition module, an image processing module, a comparison module, an irrigation module, a displayer and a remote monitoring terminal to monitor soil moisture, soil temperature, carbon dioxide concentration and fruit trees images in various areas in the hilly mountain orchard, and can learn the soil moisture, the soil temperature, the carbon dioxide concentration and the fruit trees images in each area of the hilly mountain orchard in real time. The soil moisture in each area is compared with the soil moisture threshold inthe corresponding area through the comparison module to achieve precise irrigation. At the same time, the fruit trees images are acquired through the image acquisition module in real time to monitor the growth process of the fruit trees. Dividing test areas according to the height of the hilly mountain can not only accurately irrigate the fruit trees in the hilly mountains, but also save costs.

title: Geospatial aggregating and layering of field data
abstract: Embodiments relate to storing farming activity values into geospatial containers associated with a spatial grid system, and generating data analytics therefrom. Pulse data collected by a data collection device and associated with a swath width of a farming implement can be obtained. A pulse polygon can be generated based on the swath width and location information included in the pulse data. The pulse polygon can be translated into at least one grid cell of a plurality of grid cells of a spatial grid system, such that the at least one grid cell geographically corresponds to the pulse polygon. Relevant data points extracted from the pulse data can be stored into a geospatial container generated for each grid cell of the at least one grid cell. Any of the geospatial containers can thus be selectively analyzed, independently or in combination with other geospatial containers, to derive accurate insights therefrom.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent spraying system and method based on prescription map
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent spraying system and method based on a prescription map. The system herein comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle flight decision system, anunmanned aerial vehicle precision operating system, an operating prescription system and an unmanned aerial vehicle engineering survey system. The unmanned aerial vehicle flight decision system is communicated with the unmanned aerial vehicle precision operating system through a ZigBee wireless sensing network; the unmanned aerial vehicle precision operating system is communicated with the operating prescription system through a 4G network; the operating prescription system is communicated with the unmanned aerial vehicle engineering survey system through the 4G network; the unmanned aerial vehicle engineering survey system is communicated with the unmanned aerial vehicle flight decision system through the ZigBee wireless sensing network. Soil fertility is judged via low-altitude remote sensing, decisions are made by artificial intelligence, an unmanned aerial vehicle is driven to provide precision operating in prescription map mode, and therefore, the technical problem that traditional operating modes have unreasonable application of fertilizers, low labor efficiency, non-uniform spraying, and poor fertilization effect is solved, and fine operating is achieved.

title: DEVICE FOR DETECTING CROP ROW, DEVICE FOR FOLLOWING UP CROP ROW AND FARM WORKING MACHINE
abstract:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a device for highly accurately detecting a crop row able to not only detect displacement of the crop row to a farm working machine such as a root-vegetable harvester, a weeder or the like, but suppress influence of vibration and deviation of the farm working machine to contact arms by improving followability to the crop row and, in addition, prevent the contact arms from being broken caused by sticking the arms into a ridge when the farm working machine is driven in reverse, and provide a device for following up the crop rows and the farm working machine.

SOLUTION: The device for detecting the crop row comprises a vertical motion support member 4 supported by a vertically parallel link mechanism 41 to the working machine 3 to be freely and vertically movable, a rocking frame 5 pivotted on the lower end of the vertical motion support member 4, a fixing bracket 61, a laterally parallel link 6 comprising rotary pendant brackets 62 and a rocking bracket 63, a pair of contact arms 7, 7 fixed to each end of the rotary and pendant bracket and a lateral deviation sensor 8 for detecting the deviation of the contact arms 7, 7 in the lateral direction.
