title: AUTOMATIC TRAVEL DEVICE OF WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To provide an automatic travel device of a work vehicle capable of efficiently monitoring an obstacle while reducing an electric power consumption measured by an obstacle sensor, in accordance with a travel state of the work vehicle on a target travel route, when the work vehicle is made to automatically travel along the target travel route.SOLUTION: An automatic travel device of a work vehicle includes: an automatic travel control part 18 that obtains location information by a satellite positioning system 21 and makes a work vehicle 1 automatically travel along a target travel route; a front side obstacle sensor 101; a rear side obstacle sensor 102; an obstacle control part 107 that performs obstacle detection processing for detecting an obstacle on the basis of detection information of the front side obstacle sensor 101 or the rear side obstacle sensor 102; and a sensor switching control part 110 that switches each of the front side obstacle sensor 101 and the rear side obstacle sensor 102 to an operation state or a stop state, in accordance with a travel state of the work vehicle 1 on the target travel route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Grain crop harvesting robot operation safety control device and control method
abstract: According to the operation safety control device and control method for the grain crop harvesting robot, an actual operation state of the harvesting robot can be automatically judged and recognized through the VCU, and working parts of the harvesting robot can be controlled to recover from an unsafe state to a safe state; therefore, potential safety hazards of the harvesting robot caused by the fact that a driver mistakenly touches the harvesting robot or forgets to turn off the harvesting operation switch after use can be effectively reduced, and the harvesting robot is kept in a safe state to the maximum extent.

title: METHODS FOR GENERATING SOIL MAPS AND APPLICATION PRESCRIPTIONS
abstract: Methods are provided for generating a prescription map for the application of crop inputs. In one method, the user draws a boundary on a map within a user interface and the system identifies relevant soil data and generates a soil map overlay and legend for changing the application prescription for various soils and soil conditions. In another method, the user instead drives a field boundary which is recorded on a planter monitor using a global positioning receiver, and the system generates a soil map and legend for changing the application prescription.

title: SYSTEMS, METHODS, AND/OR APPARATUS FOR PROVIDING A USER DISPLAY AND INTERFACE FOR USE WITH AN AGRICULTURAL IMPLEMENT
abstract: A display unit is connected to an agricultural implement to provide inputs and operational controls, as well as status and set up, of the implement. The display unit can be a touchscreen or other device that can receive inputs to set up, control, store information, and recall information associated with the operation of the agricultural implement. The display unit can provide a number of different types of inputs to allow for the control of the various components of the implement. An alert system can provide tiered alerts, such as based upon the severity of the alerts, to provide for notice to a user as to one or more issues associated with the implement or an operation thereof.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To provide a work vehicle for improving work efficiency.SOLUTION: A work vehicle according to one embodiment includes: a traveling vehicle body; a seedling planting part provided for the traveling vehicle body; and a control device which controls a steering angle of a steering wheel of the traveling vehicle body and causes the traveling vehicle body to travel autonomously. The control device can perform a travel assisting function to plant seedlings in the field with the seedling planting part while autonomously advancing the traveling vehicle body linearly and a turning assisting function to turn the traveling vehicle without planting seedlings with the seedling planting part. The control device can perform the traveling assisting function and the turning assisting function when manually traveled by operation of an operator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: Central irrigation control system
abstract: In one embodiment of the present invention, irrigation software is provided for an irrigation system. The irrigation software may include a hierarchical watering plan display, water pump adjustment, water pump efficiency profile use, a soil moisture interface, a historical flow interface, a demand ET interface, an instant program interface, an instant program interface, a manual irrigation interface, a precipitation management group interface, a rain schedule adjustment algorithm, a map-to-monitor button, a universal start time shift interface, and a conditional screen saver.

title: METHOD FOR PLANNING THE WORKING OF AN AGRICULTURAL FIELD
abstract: The present application relates to a method for planning working of an at least quadrilateral area (10) of an agricultural field by means of a steerable or manoeuvrable agricultural implement, wherein the area (10) has edge portions (12, 14, 16, 18) between its corners (11, 13, 15, 17) and in this case a first edge portion (12) and a second edge portion (14) opposite the first edge portion (12), and wherein the second edge portion (14) extends at an angle to the first edge portion (12). In this case, a plurality of first working paths (20) extending alongside one another and a plurality of second working paths (22) extending alongside one another are determined, a rut (24), which extends at least partially along the first working paths (20) and the second working paths (22) and along which the agricultural implement is intended to be moved over the area (10), is determined, and a plurality of turn-in points (26) along the rut (24), at which the implement is turned from a direction along one of the first working paths (20) into a direction along one of the second working paths (22), are determined, such that the rut (24) extends less along the first working paths (20) and more along the second working paths (22) with increasing distance (30) from the first edge portion (12).

title: Automatic control device for seed metering of precision seeder
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic control device for the seed metering of a precision seeder and belongs to the technical field of agricultural engineering. The device is mainly composed of a fifthwheel instrument, a single-chip microcomputer minimum system, a motor control module, a motor, a seed metering shaft, a keyboard module and a display module. According to the automatic control devicefor the seed metering of the precision seeder of the invention, the single-chip microcomputer is used for controlling the rotating speed of a seed metering device, and therefore, the seeding rate ofthe seed metering device can be effectively compensated, and the seeding rate uniformity of the seeder is improved; when the seeding rate is adjusted, a chain wheel does not need to be replaced, onlyseeding rate parameters need to be inputted, and thus, adjustment precision is improved.

title: Plant root intelligent ceramic water seepage and supply device
abstract: The invention relates to a plant root intelligent ceramic water seepage and supply device belonging to a plant irrigation rig and comprising a water supply pipe with a valve. The branch of the water supply pipe is connected with a ceramic micropore water seepage utensil buried in soil; a humidity sensor arranged at the perimeter of the ceramic micropore water seepage utensil is communicated with an intelligent controller; and the intelligent controller is connected with the valve line of the water supply pipe. The device saves water, labor and fertilizers, does not have pollution, can supplement soil moisture and nutrient in time and meanwhile cannot make the soil hardened, which is beneficial to the growth of plant roots.

title: SYSTEMS, DEVICES, AND METHODS FOR ROBOTIC REMOTE SENSING FOR PRECISION AGRICULTURE
abstract: The present subject matter relates to systems, devices, and methods for data-driven precision agriculture through close-range remote sensing with a versatile imaging system. This imaging system can be deployed onboard low-flying unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and/or carried by human scouts. Additionally, the present technology stack can include methods for extracting actionable intelligence from the rich datasets acquired by the imaging system, as well as visualization techniques for efficient analysis of the derived data products. In this way, the present systems and methods can help specialty crop growers reduce costs, save resources, and optimize crop yield.

title: Method and apparatus for zone mapping
abstract: A method and system for zone mapping displays a geographic area to a user and receives input from the user identifying a zone of the geographic area. An identification of an agricultural material to be applied in the zone is also received and an application plan is generated in response. The application plan is generated based on features identified in the zone, the agricultural material to be applied, and application requirements and restrictions associated with the agricultural material that are identified by the manufacturer of the material and, in some cases, governmental agencies. The agricultural machine tracks the application of the agricultural material and transmits application information for storage in the zone mapping system for later retrieval in response to requests, such as compliance requests.

title: Obtaining and augmenting agricultural data and generating an augmented display
abstract: A geographic position of an agricultural machine is captured. Agricultural data is received that corresponds to a geographic position. Georeferenced visual indicia are displayed that are indicative of the received agricultural data.

title: Systems for acquiring field condition data
abstract: A system for acquiring agricultural data includes a UAV with a controller and a sensing device is provided. In several embodiments, the controller is configured to receive data associated with a data collection point located within the field and control the operation of the UAV such that the UAV is flown over the field and lands in the field at the data collection point. The sensing device, in several embodiments, is configured to capture field condition data associated with the field while the UAV is maintained in a landed condition at the data collection point.

title: PREDICTIVE MAP GENERATION AND CONTROL SYSTEM
abstract: One or more information maps are obtained by an agricultural work machine. The one or more information maps map one or more agricultural characteristic values at different geographic locations of a field. An in-situ sensor on the agricultural work machine senses an agricultural characteristic as the agricultural work machine moves through the field. A predictive map generator generates a predictive map that predicts a predictive agricultural characteristic at different locations in the field based on a relationship between the values in the one or more information maps and the agricultural characteristic sensed by the in-situ sensor. The predictive map can be output and used in automated machine control.

title: Crop state map generation and control system
abstract: One or more information maps are obtained by an agricultural work machine. The one or more information maps map one or more agricultural characteristic values at different geographic locations of a field. An in-situ sensor on the agricultural work machine senses an agricultural characteristic as the agricultural work machine moves through the field. A predictive map generator generates a predictive map that predicts a predictive agricultural characteristic at different locations in the field based on a relationship between the values in the one or more information maps and the agricultural characteristic sensed by the in-situ sensor. The predictive map can be output and used in automated machine control.

title: System and method for determining soil clod size using captured images of a field
abstract: In one aspect, a system for determining soil clod size as an implement is being towed across a field by a work vehicle may include an imaging device provided in operative association with the work vehicle or the implement such that the imaging device is configured to capture images of the field. Furthermore, the system may include a controller communicatively coupled to the imaging device. The controller may be configured to receive, from the imaging device, image data associated with an imaged portion of the field. Moreover, the controller may be configured analyze the received image data to identify at least one edge of a soil clod within the imaged portion of the field. Additionally, the controller may be configured to determine a size of the soil clod based on the identified at least one edge of the soil clod.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle seeding system for pelleting seeds
abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle seeding system for pelleting seeds. The unmanned aerial vehicle seeding system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle main body and a seeding device installed on the unmanned aerial vehicle main body, wherein the seeding device comprises a seed storage box, a seed distribution mechanism and an air injection mechanism, and the seed distribution mechanism comprises a first distribution mechanism, a second distribution mechanism and a third distribution mechanism; the seed storage box is installed at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the first distribution mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the seed storage box, the first distribution mechanism is of a double-spiral structure and comprises a first spiral rod and a second spiral rod, the first spiral rod is connected with a first driving motor in a matched mode, and the second spiral rod is connected with a second driving motor in a matched mode. The unmanned aerial vehicle seeding system has the advantages that the seed metering amount can be accurately controlled, the situation that the seed metering amount is too small or too large is avoided, a guarantee is provided for efficient and accurate operation of the whole operation, the single seed metering rate is extremely high, and the single seed falling to the ground has a certain soil penetrating depth.

title: Raster-based contour swathing for guidance and variable-rate chemical application
abstract: A raster-based system for GNSS guidance includes a vehicle-mounted GNSS antenna and receiver. A processor provides guidance and/or autosteering commands based on GNSS-defined pixels forming a grid representing an area to be treated, such as a field. Specific guidance and chemical application methods are provided based on the pixel-defined treatment areas and preprogrammed chemical application prescription maps, which can include variable chemical application rates and dynamic control of the individual nozzles of a sprayer.

title: Automatic steering correction of an agricultural harvester using integration of harvester header row sensors and harvester auto guidance system
abstract: A method and system for automatically correcting a steering command from an auto guidance system to adjust for misalignments between the crop rows and the header due to errors which may include, but are not limited to a stack up of errors from the remote positioning system information translation, planter and harvester machine centerline differences, harvesting and planting pattern differences, and the like, that integrates row sensor information into the auto guidance system.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To prevent execution of automatic steering control when a positioning device is located at a second position.SOLUTION: A work vehicle comprises: a car body capable of traveling; a positioning device for detecting a location of the car body on the basis of a signal transmitted from a positioning satellite; a control device executing the automatic steering control for automatically controlling the steering of the car body on the basis of detection information detected by the positioning device; and a restraint section for restraining the automatic steering control. The positioning section can displace to a first position, the location to be used, and a second position located lower than the first position, and when the positioning device is located at the second position, the restraint section restraints it not to execute automatic steering control.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 9

title: DETECTING UNTRAVERSABLE SOIL FOR FARMING MACHINE
abstract: A farming machine moves through a field and performs one or more farming actions (e.g., treating one or more plants) in the field. Portions of the field may include moisture, such as puddles or mud patches. A control system associated with the farming machine may include a traversability model and/or a moisture model to help the farming machine operate in the field with the moisture. In particular, the control system may employ the traversability model to reduce the likelihood of the farming machine attempting to traverse an untraversable portion of the field, and the control system may employ the moisture model to reduce the likelihood of the farming machine performing an action that will damage a portion of the field.

title: System and method for automatically updating estimated yield values
abstract: System and method which automatically updates estimated field and in-transit yield values as a function of estimated vehicle load values and correction values determined from more accurate yield values obtained later, such as at a processing or other receiving facility, thereby providing better estimates of yield values between yield monitor system calibrations.

title: Tillage implement with vision sensors
abstract: A control system for a tillage implement broadly includes front and rear sensors, a leveling assembly, and a controller. The front sensor is positioned on a front of a central section, wherein the front sensor is configured to obtain height information indicative of a height of the front of the central section above a ground. The rear sensor is positioned on a rear of the central section, wherein the rear sensor is configured to obtain height information indicative of a height of the rear of the central section above the ground. The leveling assembly is configured to adjust a front to rear orientation of the central section. The controller is configured to receive the height information from the front sensor and the height information from the rear sensor, and to provide instructions to the leveling assembly to adjust the front to rear orientation of the central section based on the received height information.

title: Seeding and precise liquid fertilizer spraying device
abstract: The seeding combined liquid fertilizer precise spraying device comprises a seed box with an opening in the top, a seed metering shaft and a seed cleaning rolling brush are rotatably mounted in the seed box, a mounting shaft is further fixed in the seed box, a transmission gear is rotatably mounted on the mounting shaft, and a seed metering disc and a driving gear are fixedly mounted on the seed metering shaft; in conclusion, the seed metering device seed monitoring module is designed on the basis of an electronic control system, whether seeds exist in the seed metering wheel or not can be judged, then whether fertilization is carried out or not is judged, fertilizer waste is reduced, the phenomenon that the seeds make contact with chemical fertilizer and are damaged due to the fact that the fertilizer spraying time is wrong is eradicated, and the purpose that sowing is combined with precise liquid fertilizer spraying is achieved.

title: AN APPARATUS FOR AUTONOMOUS PRECISION FARMING AND MANAGEMENT
abstract: An apparatus for autonomous precision farming and management, comprises: at least one control unit (1); at least one crop sensing mechanism (2), said at least one crop sensing mechanism (2) comprising at least one crop sensing device (3); at least one irrigation sensing mechanism, said at least one irrigation sensing mechanism comprising: at least one irrigation sensing device (9); and at least one rain sensing device that is configured to detect rainfall, at least one nutrient sensing mechanism, said at least one nutrient sensing mechanism comprising at least one tank (7) with pump, with at least one nutrient sensing device (6) being associated with the at least one tank (7); a server (17); and an application installable on a computing device (15). The disclosed apparatus offers the following advantages: precise usage of water and farm inputs: leaves the least possible residues of farm inputs in the soil, optimized stock maintenance; purchaser and supplier predictability: and service provider optimization.

title: PRODUCT DISTRIBUTION DEVICE WITH FLOW RATE AND SECTION CONTROL MONITORING
abstract: A product distribution device is shown as embodied in an agricultural air seeder in which a mass flow sensor is used to measure the product flow through only a portion of a product flow passage wherein the total mass flow is calculated from the portion that is measured. Furthermore, the output signal from the mass flow sensor is used to determine if a device used for section control is functioning properly.

title: Large-scale precision irrigation method
abstract: The invention relates to a large-scale precision irrigation method, and relates to the technical field of agriculture. The large-scale precision irrigation method comprises a plurality of irrigation units, a data acquisition device and a central processing unit, wherein the irrigation units comprise various irrigation equipment of specified farmlands and matched farmlands; the data acquisition device comprises movable type acquisition devices or fixed type acquisition devices or both of the movable type acquisition devices and the fixed type acquisition devices; the irrigation units correspondto or do not correspond to a group of independent fixed type acquisition devices; the movable type acquisition devices correspond to the the plurality of irrigation units; the movable type acquisition devices and the fixed type acquisition devices comprise video monitoring devices; and after receiving data of the data acquisition device, the central processing unit analyzes and monitors the states of crops in the data and then controls the irrigation units to work respectively. According to the large-scale precision irrigation method provided by the invention, whether irrigation is needed ornot is judged by video-monitoring the surface states of the crops, and a large number of soil sensors are not needed, so that the large-scale precision irrigation method is relatively low in cost andsuitable for large-scale intensive farmlands.

title: SYSTEM FOR MANAGING APPARATUS FOR AEROPONIC CULTIVATION OF PLANTS
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for managing an aeroponic cultivation apparatus of plants. The system comprises: a frame part including a bottom frame having an opened portion and a vertical frame vertically installed on an edge of the bottom frame; a medium part including a foaming paper horizontally disposed in the frame part, through holes through which plants are inserted into the foaming paper, respectively, and insertion holes derived from the through holes, respectively, and configured to fix the plants in the air; a sprayer installed in an upper side of the medium part and configured to spray a nutrient solution to the plants; a water tank mounted on a lower side of the bottom frame and configured to collect and store or discharge the nutrient solution that is sprayed on the plants by the sprayer and has passed through the through holes; a plant health state measurement unit installed in the water tank and configured to identify a health state of the plants by measuring turbidity of the nutrient solution by using a turbidity sensor; and a nutrient supply part configured to adjust the turbidity of the nutrient solution by supplying the nutrient solution from an external side to the water tank according to the turbidity of the nutrient solution measured by the plant health state measurement unit. According to the present invention, the system can be remotely managed by IoT and mobile communication.

title: FIELD TRAVEL ROUTE GENERATION SYSTEM AND FIELD WORK VEHICLE
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a field travel route generation system capable of generating both a work travel route for obtaining efficient travel work and a travel route for smoothly travelling in an entrance area and starting and ending points of the work travel route.SOLUTION: A field travel route generation system includes: a field information storage section storing field information including position information of a field and its entrance area; a work travel route calculation section 61 calculating a work travel route of a field work vehicle connecting a travel work starting point and travel work ending point; a before-travel route calculation section 62 calculating a before-travel route reaching the travel work starting point of the work travel route from the entrance area; and an after-travel route calculation section 63 calculating an after-travel route reaching the entrance area from the travel work ending point.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Loader Positioning System
abstract: A loader positioning system which includes a positional sensor and visual indicators for centering a product being loaded from a loading vehicle into a receiving vehicle. The loader positioning system generally includes a loading vehicle including a dispenser for dispensing a material and a container for receiving the material. A sensor on the loading vehicle detects a distance between the loading vehicle and the container. A control unit receives and processes the positional data from the sensor and compares it to optimal spacing between the loading vehicle and the container such that the dispenser is centrally positioned over the container for central loading of the material into the container. A display in the loading vehicle provides movement instructions to an operator of the loading vehicle such that the dispenser is centrally positioned over the container for optimal loading of the material into the container.

title: Grey prediction fuzzy PID control method and device for water and fertilizer precision irrigation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of water and fertilizer irrigation control methods, and discloses a gray prediction fuzzy PID control method for water and fertilizer precision irrigation,which comprises the following steps: S1, combining a gray prediction control method, a fuzzy logic control method and a PID control method; s2, aiming at different irrigation modes and control objects, developing a serialized automatic irrigation control system; s3, adopting different irrigation modes for different plots and different crops through a serialized automatic irrigation control systemto realize precise control irrigation of water and fertilizer. The gray prediction fuzzy PID control method for water and fertilizer precision irrigation provided by the technical scheme of the invention can realize precision control of water and fertilizer irrigation.

title: FIELD WORKING VEHICLE
abstract: To provide a field working vehicle which can smoothly restart, even when a field work thereof through an automatic travel is interrupted and the vehicle is separated from a target travel route, the automatic travel from the desired resumption position.SOLUTION: A field working vehicle comprises: a separation recording unit which records a separation position Pb at the time of separation or a separation travel route LM(4) that is a target travel route at the time of separation as separation information with respect to the separation of the vehicle body occurred during the field work through an automatic travel; and a work recovery management unit which determines a resumption travel route LM(4) that is used when resuming the field work after separation on the basis of the separation information and manages the recovery to the resumption travel route LM(4) or the separation position Pb, wherein the work recovery management unit includes a determination unit determining whether transition from manual operation to the automatic travel is possible or not during a manual recovery operation in which the vehicle body goes toward the resumption travel route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title: CROP SCANNER
abstract: This disclosure relates to a system for scanning crops. A line scan distance sensor measures a distance of the crops from the sensor and generates distance data indicative of the distance of the crops from the sensor at a measurement angle. A mover system moves the line scan distance sensor or the crops perpendicular to the distance of the crops from the sensor. A rotary encoder associated with the mover system generates movement data indicative of a movement of the distance sensor or the crops perpendicular to the distance of the crops from the sensor. A data collector associates the distance data from the distance sensor with relative positioning data based on the movement data from the rotary encoder and stores the distance data associated with the relative positioning data on a data store. The system allows accurate relative spatial alignment of sequential line scans. As a result, an extremely high resolution in the direction of movement can be achieved.

title: COMPACT AND MOVEABLE HARVESTING SYSTEM FOR HARVESTING AROUND OBSTACLES IN A FIELD
abstract: An automated system for moving a crop harvester relative to an obstacle in a crop field. The system includes a sensor that is configured to sense a presence of the obstacle in the crop field, and transmit a signal corresponding to the presence of the obstacle. A motor is configured to move the crop harvester relative to the agricultural vehicle. A controller is configured to activate the motor based upon the signal received from the sensor and thereby move the crop harvester relative to the agricultural vehicle to prevent physical contact between crop harvester and the obstacle.

title: Broadband spray nozzle systems and methods
abstract: An individual spray nozzle contains two or more valves that are actuated by time or frequency modulated signals such as pulse width modulated (PWM) signals. The PWM signals are interleaved to open and close each of the respective valves that enable fluid to flow from an input to a combined output. The opening and closing positions of two or more different valves are interleaved to increase the range of performance, such as to increase the frequency of fluid flow from the input to the combined output. Additional embodiments are described.

title: Multi-information fusion rice and wheat seeder seeding rate estimation method and monitoring system
abstract: The invention provides a multi-information fusion rice and wheat seeder seeding rate estimation method and a monitoring system. The monitoring system comprises an industrial personal computer, a positioning signal receiver, a seeding flow sensor and a weighing sensor, the industrial personal computer comprises a seeding information priori estimation module, a seeding information observation module, a measurement estimation module, a priori estimation covariance solving module, a fusion coefficient solving module, a seeding information posteriori estimation module, an error covariance updating module and a seeding quantity prescription map module; the positioning signal receiver is used for detecting a geographic position signal; the plurality of seed-metering flow sensors are mounted on seed-metering ports of the rice and wheat seeding machine and are connected with the seeding information observation module; the weighing sensor is connected with the seeding information observation module; and the positioning signal receiver is used for acquiring a geographic position signal. According to the method, the accuracy of rice and wheat seeding rate and seeding flow estimation can be improved, and support is provided for subsequent accurate control of the rice and wheat seeding rate.

title: Method is for control of fruit harvesting machine and involves path follower fitted on guide bar and prevents machine from leaving its intended track
abstract: The method is for the control of a fruit harvesting machine and involves a path follower fitted on the guide bar and prevents the machine from leaving its intended track. A rotating disk (2) is in line with a guide plate (3) which moves in the track. The whole is tippable in order to deal with hindrances and obstacles in the track without problem, by reason of the hingeing effect. On the disk is a V-shaped seeking edge for appropriate action in the track. A stirrup (11) is incorporated; firstly, to lift the track or path follower, secondly, as a safety stirrup above the disk. The disk is located and rotated in the track to a depth of approximately 9 centimeters. On the under side of a guide foot is a vertical plate (3), which is in line and slides through the track. Also on the guide foot are two hinge points (4,4a), between which a hinge point (5) rotates around a bolt (6). On the hinge point is a pin (9), to which the guide bar (7) of the machine is fixed.

title: Steering authority control for a vehicle
abstract: A vehicle includes a rear steering system and a front differential hydraulic drive system. A first front drive control valve is operable to output a defined fluid flow in response to a steering command input. A second front drive control valve is operable to selectively divert a portion of the defined fluid flow output from the first front drive control valve. When the vehicle is operating in a pre-defined condition, a steering controller may control the second front drive control valve to divert a portion of the defined fluid flow from the first front drive control valve to define a reduced fluid flow, which is communicated to the front differential hydraulic drive system, to reduce a steering ratio of the front differential hydraulic drive system relative to the rear steering system, to desensitize steering provided by the front differential hydraulic drive system.

title: Systems and methods for sorting seedlings for planting
abstract: A germination facility includes a seedling growing system configured to grow a plurality of seedlings; and a seedling sorting device configured to receive spatially variable planting data regarding a planting area for planting the seedlings; receive seedling data regarding the plurality of seedlings; and arrange the plurality of seedlings in a planting container based on the seedling data and on the planting data.

title: Crop yield determining apparatus
abstract: A cotton harvester estimates the mass of cotton as it is harvested using sensor devices and compares the mass of each module against the estimated mass of the module as determined by the sensors so that a calibration factor may be determined and actively updated for more accurate crop yield determination. The mass flow for a specific module is accumulated and processed during harvesting using a base calibration factor and the module is weighed and compared against the expected mass using the base calibration factor to develop a candidate updated calibration factor. The base calibration factor is selectively replaced by the candidate updated calibration factor for processing a subsequent module based on machine feedback information relating to the operation of the harvester. Harvested crop data determined using the calibration factor is used to generate highly accurate yield maps.

title: CROP PRODUCTION, PLANNING, MANAGEMENT, TRACKING AND REPORTING SYSTEM AND METHOD
abstract: The present invention industrially relates to a system and method for production, planning, tracking, and reporting of a crop or other agricultural product. More particularly, the present invention industrially relates to crop production, planning, tracking, and reporting by coupling an identification to a crop while simultaneously collecting data throughout the crop growth process. The coupled identification relates the crop to the collected data.

title: METHOD FOR DIAGNOSING AND MONITORING A TARGET ELEMENT OF A FARM
abstract: A system (1) for monitoring and alerting a target natural element (20) of a farm, comprising a platform (2) for diagnosing the target element (20) comprising a plurality of diagnostic sensors (3) and a module (4) for recording and analysing parameters, a pointer module (6) designed to receive an input indicating that a target state of the target element (20) is ongoing or about to occur, a platform (10) for monitoring said target element comprising a plurality of monitoring sensors (13) and a monitoring module (11) designed to monitor the data with respect to the physical conditions associated with the evolution of said target element (20) and/or of its environment (21).

title: Automatic drip irrigation accurate water applying method and system based on rotation irrigation group
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic drip irrigation accurate water applying method and system based on a rotation irrigation group. The method is characterized in that the method includes the steps of: (1) collecting soil moisture information of a water applying central area of each branch pipe of a drip irrigation project, and conducting calculation to obtain a branch pipe water applying time prescription map based on the collected soil moisture information; (2) based on the calculated branch pipe water application time prescription map, establishing a multi-objective optimization model based on rotational irrigation group flow balance and shortest water application time, and determining constraint conditions of the multi-objective optimization model; and (3) performing optimization solution on the multi-objective optimization model constructed in the step (2) by adopting a non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm, and arranging an automatic drip irrigation control electromagnetic valve to implement irrigation based on obtained water application time of each rotation irrigation group. The automatic drip irrigation accurate water applying method and system based on the rotation irrigation group can be widely applied to the field of drip irrigation engineering.

title: System and method for operating ground engaging tools based on measured soil moisture
abstract: A system for limiting plugging within an agricultural implement. The system includes a ground engaging tool configured to be supported by the agricultural implement. An actuator is coupled to the ground engaging tool. The actuator is operable to apply a down pressure on the ground engaging tool. A soil moisture sensor is positioned forward of the ground engaging tool. The soil moisture sensor is configured to measure a soil moisture forward of the ground engaging tool. A controller is communicatively coupled to the soil moisture sensor. The controller is configured to receive, from the soil moisture sensor, a signal that corresponds to the soil moisture forward of the ground engaging tool. The controller is further configured to adjust the down pressure on the ground engaging tool applied by the actuator based at least in part on the signal from the soil moisture sensor.

title: AUTONOMOUS TRAVELLING SERVICE VEHICLE
abstract: In the prior art, detection sensitivity was fixed for an obstacle detection means provided to an autonomous travelling service vehicle; therefore, in the present invention an autonomous travelling service vehicle is provided with a position calculation means that determines the position of the chassis using a satellite positioning system, and with a control device that automatically drives the vehicle along a set travel route and causes the vehicle to execute the service, wherein an obstacle sensor that acts as an obstacle detection means for detecting whether or not an obstacle is present around the autonomous travelling service vehicle and a sensitivity adjustment means for adjusting the sensitivity of the obstacle sensor are provided, and the sensitivity of the obstacle sensor is adjusted by the sensitivity adjustment means so as to be high within a set work area and low outside the set work area.

title: Irrigation water conservation with automated water budgeting and time of use technology
abstract: The present invention provides a multitude of embodiments for landscape water conservation with automated water budgeting or seasonal adjustment. Water budget automation may be implemented within an irrigation controller, by means of an add-on or a plug-in to the controller, or broadcast from a central location. The environmental data used for automated water budgeting may be historical including ambient temperature, wind, solar radiation, relative humidity, soil moisture, soil temperature, or evapotranspiration, or combinations thereof, or with a combination of current sensor data. The automated water budgeting may be accomplished with a percentage accumulation method which adjusts watering intervals and schedules, or on a daily percentage basis. In addition, government based restricted watering schedules may be combined within all the above embodiments to provide additional flexibility for water conservation.

title: Method for creating spiral swath patterns for convex polygon shaped field boundaries
abstract: A computationally efficient method for generating a spiral swath pattern for a region of a field bounded by a convex polygon, the method automatically generating curved portions for the swath pattern having radii of curvature greater than a minimum turning radius based on the minimum turning radius and a definition of the field boundary.

title: Variable gain logic for a GPS based automatic steering system
abstract: A method is provided for controlling steering oscillations in a work vehicle having a closed loop GPS based automatic steering system, wherein the closed loop steering system has a default gain and a user defined gain. The method causes the system to automatically apply the default gain when an implement is raised and/or when a steering oscillation has been detected and to automatically apply the user defined gain when the implement has been lowered and/or the GPS track has been acquired.

title: ELECTRIC TRACTOR
abstract: To avoid lowering of the work efficiency of an electric tractor under a condition where input/output power of a battery is limited.SOLUTION: An electric tractor comprises a vehicle body, a working machine, an electric motor, a battery, and an inverter for controlling input/output power of the battery. The electric tractor comprises a control device for controlling the inverter. The control device performs limit processing, charge rate calculation processing, and relaxation processing. In the limit processing, when a state of the battery satisfies a predetermined limit condition, the control device controls the inverter so that an input and an output of the battery are limited within a predetermined regulation power range. In the charge rate calculation processing, the control device calculates a charge rate of the battery when it is assumed that the tractor has finished work in a farm field as an estimated charge rate. In the relaxation processing, when the estimated charge rate calculated in the charge rate calculation processing is higher than a first regulation charge rate, the control device widens the regulation power range.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: METHOD, VEHICLE AND SYSTEM FOR WEED CONTROL MANAGEMENT
abstract: The present invention relates to a method (10) to control weeds comprising the steps of: a) acquiring geopositional information of planted crop seeds on an agricultural field and generating a crop seed map, b) acquiring soil elevation data and the corresponding geopositional information of the soil elevation on the agricultural field where the crop seeds have been planted or are being planted at at least two different time points and generating soil surface profile maps of the agricultural field, the soil surface profile maps showing the soil surface profiles at the at least two different time points, c) comparing the soil surface profile maps and the crop seed map to identify differences in the soil elevation profile that are not associated with seed growth of the planted seeds on the agricultural field, d) generating a weed control agent spray map on the basis of the differences in the identified soil elevations on the agricultural field that are not associated with seed growth of the planted crop seeds on the agricultural field.

title: Miss-seeding-preventing variable-speed reseeding mechanism of scoop-wheel type seed metering device
abstract: The invention relates to a miss-seeding-preventing variable-speed reseeding mechanism of a scoop-wheel type seed metering device and belongs to agricultural machinery. The miss-seeding-preventing variable-speed reseeding mechanism is characterized in that transmitting-receiving type photoelectric sensors are coaxially mounted on the end face parts at the circumferential outer edges of the shell and the cover of the scoop-wheel type seed metering device, a single-chip microcomputer is respectively communicated with the transmitting-receiving type photoelectric sensors and a stepping motor through wires, and the motor shaft of the stepping motor is connected with the power input shaft of the scoop-wheel type seed metering device through a coupler. The miss-seeding-preventing variable-speed reseeding mechanism has the advantages that real-time detection is combined with variable-speed reseeding, synchronous timely reseeding when miss-seeding of the scoop-wheel type seed metering device occurs is achieved, and the miss-seeding-preventing variable-speed reseeding mechanism is novel, reasonable and simple in structure, high in intelligence level, fast in response, good in real-time reseeding effect and high in adaptability.

title: Portable spray application equipment controlled by gps for teaching and research use (Machine-translation by Google Translate, not legally binding)
abstract: The present invention consists of a portable spray application equipment controlled by gps for teaching and research use that allows the application of localized herbicide based on weed maps with a spray system controlled by gps, integrating elements of the same platform into a single platform. Positioning, measurement instrumentation and variable application technology for teaching and research use. The invention falls within the precision agriculture and engineering of natural resources. title: Agricultural apparatus for sensing and providing feedback of soil property changes in real time
abstract: A planting row unit is attachable to a towing frame and is movable in a forward direction on a field having soil of varying hardness conditions. The planting row unit includes an opener device forward of the towing frame for preparing the soil for receiving at least one of the fertilizer and the seeds. The opener device includes a soil-hardness sensor for detecting changes in soil-hardness conditions and an opener blade for maintaining, in response to the changes, a constant soil-penetration depth Z in the soil independent of the varying hardness conditions. A modular actuator is mounted to the opener device for applying pressure to the opener blade, the modular actuator being mountable to at least one other component of the planting row unit for applying pressure.

title: Method and device for determining field working parameter
abstract: Tractor operating parameters determined by the tractor-based processor (6) are transferred to the agricultural machinery-based processor (4), where they are combined with the agricultural machinery operating parameters and the parameters for working the field are derived from this combination of operating parameters. <??>An Independent claim is also included for the system used to carry out this method.

title: Weighted multi-year yield analysis for prescription mapping in site-specific variable rate applications in precision agriculture
abstract: A multi-year yield analysis in precision agriculture characterizes variables affecting crop yield to enable site-specific prescription mapping for a bounded field for one or more crops in the field. The multi-year yield analysis enables recommendations for variable-rate applications to the bounded field such as seeding, fertilizing, tilling, and applying crop treatments. The multi-year yield analysis evaluates each of coverage data, uniformity data, age data, and weather data related to crop yield in the bounded field.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To provide a work vehicle capable of executing a plurality of operations involved in automatic steering with excellent operability.SOLUTION: A work vehicle includes: a steering handle; a steering shaft for rotatably supporting the steering handle; a vehicle body capable of travelling either by manual steering by the steering handle or by automatic steering by the steering handle on the basis of a travelling planned line; and a steering change-over switch disposed around the steering shaft, which is swingable between a first direction for switching between start and end of the automatic steering with a base end part provided on a steering shaft side as a supporting point, and a second direction for setting a starting point and a terminal point of a travelling reference line that serves as a reference for the travelling planned line.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 14

title: Intelligent inter-row mechanical weeding machine
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent inter-row mechanical weeding machine, which comprises a stander, a crop recognizing machine vision system, a sideslip compensation control system, a depth adjusting system and an inter-row weeding device. The intelligent inter-row mechanical weeding machine is towed by a farm tractor to move ahead through the connection between a three-point suspension mechanism on the stander and a three-point suspension mechanism on the farm tractor; the crop recognizing machine vision system is used for collecting row information of crops and position information of each crop; the sideslip compensation control system can adjust the inter-row weeding device to follow the crop rows; the depth adjusting system is used for controlling a depth of a weeding blade tooth in the soil, and profiling land wheels are used for controlling the consistency of the depth of the weeding blade teeth in the soil; and the inter-row weeding device is used for controlling each weeding blade tooth to enter an inter-row area or to get out of the way of the crop. Due to the adoption of the intelligent inter-row mechanical weeding machine, the requirement on the precision of a towing tractor for following the crop rows is low, and the dependence of the inter-row weeding device on the high-precision following of a weeding robot or the towing tractor to the crop rows can be reduced.

title: YIELD MONITORING SYSTEMS AND METHODS
abstract: A system for determining performance data of plants growing in a field. The system comprises a mass flow meter for generating mass data related to the mass of plant product passed through the mass flow meter, and that is communicatively connected to a computer based data processing system; a temperature sensor for determining the temperature of the air adjacent the mass flow meter or within the mass flow meter, and that communicatively connected to the computer based data processing system, and a moisture sensor for determining the moisture of air adjacent the mass flow meter or within the mass flow meter, and that is communicatively connected to the computer based data processing system. The computer based data processing system is structured and operable to utilize the mass data, the air temperature and the air moisture to determine a yield of the plants from which the plant product was harvested.

title: Particle variable rate fertilization system
abstract: The invention relates to a particle variable rate fertilization system and a control method thereof. The particle variable rate fertilization system is arranged on a fertilization machine, and the particle variable rate fertilization system specifically comprises a Beidou navigation module, an upper computer interaction module, a lower computer control module and a mechanism execution module, wherein the Beidou navigation module conducts positioning calculation processing to obtain the position coordinate and speed of the fertilization machine according to a Beidou navigation satellite signal; the upper computer interaction module obtains the current fertilization target flow and the current fertilization target opening degree according to the current fertilization machine positioning coordinate and speed and the variable fertilization electronic prescription map; the lower computer control module generates a current push rod target extension length according to the current fertilization target opening degree, and the motion direction instruction and the speed instruction of a push rod are obtained according to the current actual extension length of the push rod; the mechanism execution module controls the real-time extension length of the push rod to change according to the motion direction instruction and the speed instruction, so that particle variable-rate fertilization is realized, that is, the quality of fertilizers spread in each square meter of soil is determined according to the nutrient demand of the soil, and different positions are different. According to the particle variable rate fertilization system, the accuracy and intelligence of variable rate fertilization operation can be effectively improved.

title: Hybrid flow nozzle and control system
abstract: Embodiments include individual physical spray nozzles that have passageways inside to combine fluids that flow out of the spray nozzles. The nozzles have at least two valves that are opened and closed in an interleaved manner. The nozzles have multiple outlets. Such nozzles are mounted on a variety of implements including agricultural or industrial spray booms.

title: DRIVING CONTROL METHOD FOR VARIABLE AGRICULTURAL ROBOT
abstract: A driving control method for a variable agricultural robot for performing work while moving along a pre-set driving path of a farm, according to the present invention, comprises: a driving path verifying step for verifying whether the pre-set driving path has changed considering at least one of a degree of change in a surrounding environment and a growing rate of crops; a driving determining step for, when it is determined by the driving path verifying step that the pre-set driving path has changed, determining whether the agricultural robot is able to be driven while maintaining the pre-set driving path; a driving path setting step for, when it is determined by the driving determining step that it is not possible for the agricultural robot to be driven while maintaining the pre-set driving path, performing a driving path changing process by using an image related to the surrounding environment; and a driving step for, when an unexpected obstruction appears while the agricultural robot is driven along the pre-set driving path or a changed driving path, performing an obstruction overcoming process by varying a shape of the agricultural robot.

title: System for estimating field conditions and associated methods for adjusting operating parameters of an agricultural machine based on estimated field conditions
abstract: In one aspect, a system for estimating field conditions may include an agricultural machine having a tire configured to engage soil within a field. The system may also include an image capture device configured to capture one or more images of the tire as the agricultural machine is moved across the field. Furthermore, the system may include a controller communicatively coupled to the image capture device. As such, the controller may be configured to estimate a parameter associated with a soil condition of the soil within the field based on the one or more images captured by the image capture device.

title: WORK VEHICLE
abstract: To provide a work vehicle capable of automatically travelling along a target route with a high degree of precision regardless of work site conditions or a travelling state of the work vehicle.SOLUTION: A work vehicle includes a positioning unit 5 for measuring a present position and a present direction of a vehicle body 1 by using a satellite positioning system, and an automatic travelling control part 40 for executing automatic travelling control based on the positioning information from the positioning unit 5. The positioning unit 5 includes a plurality of positioning antennas 5A and 5B installed on the vehicle body, a plurality of positioning parts 5C and 5D for measuring the positions of the positioning antennas 5A and 5B, a calculation part 5F for calculating the present position and the present direction of the vehicle body 1 based on the positioning information from the positioning parts 5C and 5D, and a positioning state determination part 5F for determining whether or not the positioning state of the positioning parts 5c and 5D is a high precision positioning state. The positioning state determination part 5F permits the start of the automatic travelling control when at least two of the positioning parts 5c and 5D are in the high precision positioning state.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
